name: Octocrylene production, GLO
comment: Complete 7-step synthesis route for Octocrylene (2-ethylhexyl 2-cyano-3,3-diphenylprop-2-enoate), a UV filter for cosmetics. Step 1: Knoevenagel condensation (ethyl cyanoacetate + benzophenone → Etocrylene). Step 2: Acetoacetic ester alkylation (ethyl acetoacetate + butyl bromide → ethyl 2-acetylhexanoate). Step 3: Selective ketone reduction (ethyl 2-acetylhexanoate + H2 → ethyl 2-(1-hydroxyethyl)hexanoate). Step 4: Ester hydrolysis (ethyl 2-(1-hydroxyethyl)hexanoate + H2O → 2-(1-hydroxyethyl)hexanoic acid). Step 5: Diol formation (2-(1-hydroxyethyl)hexanoic acid + CH4 → 2-butylbutane-1,3-diol). Step 6: Decarbonylation (2-butylbutane-1,3-diol + CO → 2-ethylhexanol + CO2). Step 7: Transesterification (Etocrylene + 2-ethylhexanol → Octocrylene + ethanol). Normalized to 1 kg Octocrylene reference product.

nodes.name: Octocrylene production
nodes.product_information: 2-Ethylhexyl 2-cyano-3,3-diphenylprop-2-enoate. UV filter for cosmetics and sunscreens.
nodes.comment: Transesterification of Etocrylene with 2-ethylhexanol. Acid-catalyzed at 60-120°C under atmospheric to slightly elevated pressure. Catalyst: TiCl4, SnCl2, or p-toluenesulfonic acid (0.1-1 wt%). Solvent: Toluene/Xylene. Reaction time: 2-8 hours. Ethanol removal via distillation under reduced pressure.

exchanges.name: Etocrylene
exchanges.comment: Molar ratio 1:1 normalized to 1 kg Octocrylene (C24H27NO2, MW 361.5). Etocrylene MW 277.3: 277.3/361.5 = 0.767 kg

exchanges.name: 2-Ethylhexanol
exchanges.comment: Molar ratio 1:1 normalized. 2-Ethylhexanol MW 130.23: 130.23/361.5 = 0.360 kg

exchanges.name: Ethanol
exchanges.comment: By-product credit from transesterification. System expansion: 1 mol ethanol (MW 46.04) per 1 mol Octocrylene = -0.127 kg. Negative amount represents avoided production.

exchanges.name: Titanium tetrachloride
exchanges.comment: Acid catalyst at 0.5 wt% of product mass

exchanges.name: Toluene
exchanges.comment: Solvent carrier, assumed 30% of product mass. Recovered via distillation.

exchanges.name: Electricity, medium voltage
exchanges.comment: Stirring, heating, distillation columns. Estimated 0.8 kWh per kg product for batch process.

exchanges.name: Heat, process
exchanges.comment: Heating to 60-120°C and distillation. Estimated 2.5 MJ per kg (exothermic transesterification partially offsets heating demand).

exchanges.name: Carbon dioxide
exchanges.comment: CO2 from combustion for heating and solvent evaporation losses (~15% of product mass).

exchanges.name: Waste water
exchanges.comment: From workup, neutralization, and washing steps. Contains residual catalyst and salts.

nodes.name: Etocrylene production
nodes.product_information: Ethyl 2-cyano-3,3-diphenylprop-2-enoate. UV-absorbing intermediate and cosmetic ingredient.
nodes.comment: Knoevenagel condensation: ethyl cyanoacetate + benzophenone → Etocrylene + water. Base-catalyzed at 25-80°C. Catalyst: piperidine or DBU (~5 mol%). Solvent: DMF or DMSO. Reaction time: 2-24 hours.

exchanges.name: Ethyl cyanoacetate
exchanges.comment: Molar ratio 1:1 normalized. Ethyl cyanoacetate (C5H7NO2, MW 113.11) to Etocrylene (C18H15NO2, MW 277.3): 113.11/277.3 = 0.408 kg

exchanges.name: Benzophenone
exchanges.comment: Molar ratio 1:1 normalized. Benzophenone (C13H10O, MW 182.22): 182.22/277.3 = 0.657 kg

exchanges.name: Water
exchanges.comment: By-product credit. System expansion: 1 mol H2O (MW 18.015) per 1 mol Etocrylene = -0.065 kg (avoided water production, negligible impact but structurally correct).

exchanges.name: Piperidine
exchanges.comment: Base catalyst at ~5 mol% (~1 wt% recovery assumed)

exchanges.name: Dimethylformamide
exchanges.comment: Polar aprotic solvent, assumed 50% of product mass. Recovered via distillation.

exchanges.name: Electricity, medium voltage
exchanges.comment: Stirring, temperature control. Estimated 0.6 kWh per kg.

exchanges.name: Heat, process
exchanges.comment: Heating to 25-80°C. Estimated 1.2 MJ per kg.

exchanges.name: Carbon dioxide
exchanges.comment: CO2 from solvent evaporation and combustion for heating (~8% of product mass).

exchanges.name: Waste water
exchanges.comment: From washing and workup steps.

nodes.name: 2-Ethylhexanol production
nodes.product_information: 2-Ethylhexan-1-ol. Used as solvent and in synthesis of plasticizers, detergents, and cosmetics.
nodes.comment: Two-step synthesis: (1) Decarbonylation of 2-butylbutane-1,3-diol to 2-ethylhexanol via CO reduction (100-150°C, 1-5 atm CO, Rh catalyst). (2) CO is oxidized to CO2 byproduct. Alternatively sourced from reduction of 2-butylbutane-1,3-diol.

exchanges.name: 2-Butylbutane-1,3-diol
exchanges.comment: Molar ratio 1:1 (decarbonylation). 2-Butylbutane-1,3-diol (C8H18O2, MW 146.23) to 2-Ethylhexanol (C8H18O, MW 130.23): 146.23/130.23 = 1.123 kg

exchanges.name: Carbon monoxide
exchanges.comment: Reducing agent for decarbonylation. Molar ratio 1:1: CO (MW 28.01) to 2-Ethylhexanol: 28.01/130.23 = 0.215 kg

exchanges.name: Carbon dioxide
exchanges.comment: By-product credit from CO oxidation in decarbonylation. 1 mol CO → 1 mol CO2 (MW 44.009): -44.009/130.23 = -0.338 kg. Negative amount represents avoided CO2 production (system expansion credit).

exchanges.name: Rhodium
exchanges.comment: Transition metal catalyst at ~0.1 wt% loading (catalytic, not consumed)

exchanges.name: Toluene
exchanges.comment: Aromatic solvent carrier, assumed 40% of product mass. Recovered.

exchanges.name: Electricity, medium voltage
exchanges.comment: CO gas circulation, heating, stirring. Estimated 0.5 kWh per kg.

exchanges.name: Heat, process
exchanges.comment: Heating to 100-150°C under CO atmosphere. Estimated 1.8 MJ per kg.

exchanges.name: Carbon dioxide
exchanges.comment: CO2 from combustion for heating and decarbonylation side reactions (~12% of product mass).

exchanges.name: Waste water
exchanges.comment: From workup and extraction steps.

nodes.name: 2-Butylbutane-1,3-diol production
nodes.product_information: 2-Butylbutane-1,3-diol. Used as intermediate in synthesis of 2-ethylhexanol and specialty alcohols.
nodes.comment: Formed via decarboxylative reduction of 2-(1-hydroxyethyl)hexanoic acid. Reaction: C8H16O3 + CH4 → C8H18O2 + CH2O. Temperature and pressure conditions not well-defined in source (ambiguous reaction mechanism).

exchanges.name: 2-(1-Hydroxyethyl)hexanoic acid
exchanges.comment: Molar ratio 1:1 normalized. Hydroxy acid (C8H16O3, MW 160.21) to diol (C8H18O2, MW 146.23): 160.21/146.23 = 1.091 kg

exchanges.name: Methane
exchanges.comment: Reducing agent, molar ratio 1:1. Methane (CH4, MW 16.043) to diol: 16.043/146.23 = 0.109 kg

exchanges.name: Formaldehyde
exchanges.comment: By-product credit. 1 mol formaldehyde (MW 30.026) per 1 mol diol = -30.026/146.23 = -0.205 kg (avoided formaldehyde production).

exchanges.name: Electricity, medium voltage
exchanges.comment: Stirring and temperature control. Estimated 0.3 kWh per kg.

exchanges.name: Heat, process
exchanges.comment: Process heating (conditions not fully specified). Estimated 0.8 MJ per kg.

exchanges.name: Carbon dioxide
exchanges.comment: CO2 from combustion for heating (~6% of product mass). Reaction mechanism ambiguity limits precision.

exchanges.name: Waste water
exchanges.comment: Minimal water emission from this step (dry reaction).

nodes.name: 2-(1-Hydroxyethyl)hexanoic acid production
nodes.comment: Ester hydrolysis of ethyl 2-(1-hydroxyethyl)hexanoate. Acid-catalyzed (H2SO4 or HCl, 0.5-2 wt%) at 70-85°C in aqueous ethanol. Reaction time 2-6 hours.

exchanges.name: Ethyl 2-(1-hydroxyethyl)hexanoate
exchanges.comment: Ester hydrolysis, molar ratio 1:1. Ester (C10H20O3, MW 188.26) to acid (C8H16O3, MW 160.21): 188.26/160.21 = 1.173 kg

exchanges.name: Water
exchanges.comment: Process water input for hydrolysis. Molar ratio 1:1 to ester: 18.015/188.26 = 0.096 kg (conservatively estimated 0.106 kg including washing).

exchanges.name: Ethanol
exchanges.comment: By-product credit from ester hydrolysis. 1 mol ethanol (MW 46.04) per 1 mol ester = -46.04/188.26 = -0.244 kg (system expansion credit).

exchanges.name: Sulfuric acid
exchanges.comment: Acid catalyst at 1 wt% (partially neutralized and recovered/recycled).

exchanges.name: Electricity, medium voltage
exchanges.comment: Stirring and heating. Estimated 0.2 kWh per kg.

exchanges.name: Heat, process
exchanges.comment: Heating to 70-85°C for hydrolysis. Estimated 1.0 MJ per kg.

exchanges.name: Carbon dioxide
exchanges.comment: CO2 from combustion for heating (~5% of product mass).

exchanges.name: Waste water
exchanges.comment: Aqueous waste stream containing dilute H2SO4, residual ethanol, salts. Requires neutralization.

nodes.name: Ethyl 2-(1-hydroxyethyl)hexanoate production
nodes.comment: Selective catalytic hydrogenation of ethyl 2-acetylhexanoate. Reduces ketone to secondary alcohol while preserving ester. Temperature 50-150°C, H2 pressure 1-50 bar. Catalyst: Ni/C, Pd/C, or Pt/C at 5-10 wt%.

exchanges.name: Ethyl 2-acetylhexanoate
exchanges.comment: Ketone-ester substrate, molar ratio 1:1. Ketone ester (C10H18O3, MW 186.25) to hydroxy ester (C10H20O3, MW 188.26): 186.25/188.26 = 0.990 kg

exchanges.name: Hydrogen
exchanges.comment: Hydrogenation gas, molar ratio ~1:1 for ketone reduction. H2 (MW 2.016) to ester: ~2.016/188.26 = 0.011 kg

exchanges.name: Nickel
exchanges.comment: Heterogeneous catalyst (Ni/C) at 5-10 wt% loading (catalytic, partially recovered).

exchanges.name: Ethanol
exchanges.comment: Protic solvent for hydrogenation, assumed 30% of product mass. Recovered.

exchanges.name: Electricity, medium voltage
exchanges.comment: Autoclave operation, gas circulation, stirring. Estimated 0.7 kWh per kg.

exchanges.name: Heat, process
exchanges.comment: Heating to 50-150°C under H2 pressure. Estimated 1.5 MJ per kg (exothermic hydrogenation partially compensates).

exchanges.name: Carbon dioxide
exchanges.comment: CO2 from combustion for heating and autoclave operation (~7% of product mass).

exchanges.name: Waste water
exchanges.comment: Minimal water in hydrogenation (non-aqueous process), mainly from workup washing.

nodes.name: Ethyl 2-acetylhexanoate production
nodes.product_information: Ethyl 2-acetylhexanoate. β-Ketoester intermediate used in acetoacetic ester synthesis.
nodes.comment: Acetoacetic ester synthesis: SN2 alkylation of ethyl acetoacetate with butyl bromide. Base-catalyzed (NaEt or K2CO3). Temperature 20-80°C, reaction time 2-24 hours. Solvent: ethanol or DMSO.

exchanges.name: Ethyl acetoacetate
exchanges.comment: β-Ketoester starting material, molar ratio 1:1. Ethyl acetoacetate (C6H10O3, MW 130.14) to product (C10H18O3, MW 186.25): 130.14/186.25 = 0.698 kg

exchanges.name: 1-Bromobutane
exchanges.comment: Alkyl halide nucleophile, molar ratio 1:1. Butyl bromide (C4H9Br, MW 137.02) to product: 137.02/186.25 = 0.736 kg

exchanges.name: Hydrogen bromide
exchanges.comment: By-product credit from SN2 displacement. 1 mol HBr (MW 80.91) per 1 mol product = -80.91/186.25 = -0.429 kg (system expansion, avoided HBr production).

exchanges.name: Sodium ethoxide
exchanges.comment: Base catalyst (1-2 equiv, assuming 1.5% use on alkylation). Molar excess consumed.

exchanges.name: Ethanol
exchanges.comment: Solvent for alkylation, assumed 40% of product mass. Recovered.

exchanges.name: Electricity, medium voltage
exchanges.comment: Stirring and temperature control. Estimated 0.4 kWh per kg.

exchanges.name: Heat, process
exchanges.comment: Moderate heating 20-80°C (exothermic SN2 reaction). Estimated 0.9 MJ per kg.

exchanges.name: Carbon dioxide
exchanges.comment: CO2 from combustion for heating and solvent evaporation (~9% of product mass).

exchanges.name: Waste water
exchanges.comment: Aqueous waste from base neutralization, salt precipitation, and washing.
